CashMovement.name: Cash Movement
CashMovement.definition: Specifies whether the cash amount is to be delivered or received.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account in which cash is maintained.

CollateralMovement.name: Collateral Movement
CollateralMovement.definition: Specifies whether the amount is delivered/received as part of collateral or not.

CashMovementApproved.name: Cash Movement Approved
CashMovementApproved.definition: Indicates whether the proposed cash movements can be accepted.

PositionType.name: Position Type
PositionType.definition: Indicates whether the position is fixed (post settlement).

ClientCashMovementIdentification.name: Client Cash Movement Identification
ClientCashMovementIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by party A to the cash movement.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCashMovement.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Cash Movement Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCashMovement.definition: Identification assigned by the triparty-agent/service-provider to the cash movement.
